metrics.label: Demographic Parity
metrics.description: Gap in approval rate between groups, regardless of whether they would repay.

metrics.label: Equal Opportunity
metrics.description: Gap in approval rate among applicants who would actually repay the loan.

metrics.label: Predictive Parity
metrics.description: Gap in precision: of those approved, how many actually repay, across groups.

metrics.label: Calibration
metrics.description: Gap between predicted probability and actual repayment rate across score bins.

worst_dimension.label: Demographic Parity
worst_dimension.explanation: Male applicants are approved 12.4 percentage points more often than female applicants (74.2% vs 61.8%). This is the largest disparity FairScore detected and exceeds the 10% concern threshold.
